scope: Declared before extracting new physical geometry; existing candidate simulations already completed, so NOT preregistered independent validation
limitations: Human central OCT and model whole400um cross-section have no homologous regional/measurement mapping.
Column span is not top-cell yCOM or OCT-normal optical thickness; gaps and missing columns retained.
Spatial columns/timepoints are not independent animals or human subjects.
Clinical mean differences are descriptive, not paired RMSE, equivalence, accuracy percentage or biological pass.
No acceptance threshold/parameter is fitted after candidate outcomes.
Rabbit mechanical injury/fluorescein surface area is not chemical-model basal exposure.
Calibration independence needs external evidence; dataset download does not establish holdout status.
